$room..read: auth != null && $room.matches(/^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{6}$/) && (!data.exists() || data.child('status').val() == 'waiting' || data.child('hostUid').val() == auth.uid || data.child('guestUid').val() == auth.uid)

status..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.parent().child('hostUid').val() == auth.uid && newData.val() == 'waiting') || (data.val() == 'waiting' && newData.val() == 'playing' && newData.parent().child('guestUid').val() == auth.uid))

state..write: auth != null && (data.parent().child('hostUid').val() == auth.uid || data.parent().child('guestUid').val() == auth.uid || newData.parent().child('hostUid').val() == auth.uid)
state..validate: newData.hasChildren(['players', 'size', 'mode', 'turn', 'scores', 'complete']) && newData.child('mode').val() == 'online' && newData.child('size').isNumber() && newData.child('size').val() >= 4 && newData.child('size').val() <= 10 && newData.child('turn').isNumber() && newData.child('turn').val() >= 0 && newData.child('turn').val() <= 1 && newData.child('players/0').isString() && newData.child('players/1').isString() && newData.child('scores/0').isNumber() && newData.child('scores/1').isNumber() && newData.child('complete').isBoolean()
